scientific_integrity.scientific_claim: Uniform high-reset-rate fractional cusp correction and exponential detuning profile for stationary mean and averaged recovery equilibrium.

scientific_limitations: Adiabatic frozen-parameter reduction, not a finite-slow-timescale theorem.
Fixed D>0, fixed McKean slopes and bounded detuning in the high-r limit; no uniform D downarrow 0 assertion.
Originality may be limited by general short-time-resolvent boundary-layer results that have not been fully ruled out.
title: A universal exponential cusp layer for strongly reset McKean neurons
